scope: Synthetic immutable observation batches; no stepping, long sessions, official servers or playing-strength inference.

build.profile: locked release, thin LTO, codegen-units=1, no RUSTFLAGS

metric_notes: Windows process CPU is kernel+user and quantized to approximately15.625ms; candidate empty-path totals are particularly short.
Peak working set is resident memory, not allocation or combined simultaneous memory.
Materialization and output destruction use separate Instant wall intervals, not CPU or internal phase attribution.
Process CPU/wall include setup, both timed intervals, loop/clock/sample overhead, reporting and teardown.
Operation tail latency/throughput refer to whole batches with the stated mask, not individual entities.
Peer coordination does not establish whole-machine isolation. All outliers are retained; no confidence intervals or transfer claim.
